material.description: NAMED (LPwb hay_bale), OVERRIDE (APms, AOnt, APtv, LObz, VOfl) and the custom-code PARENT map (D00x resolve to a parent kind) in scenarios/moba/tools/gen-doodad-types-w3.mjs still set shipped kinds. Commit 9400c259 withheld 24 such rows in doodad-types-w3.tsv by hand, so the next regeneration would undo it. The generator is also out of sync with the TSV: AWlp, APct and the other hand-named rows have no generator path. Its working tree differs from origin, so the owning lane must change it.
material.subject: gen-doodad-types-w3.mjs still ships the kinds 6.88g does not give, so regenerating the w3 table restores them
material.witness: Row resolved. Generator now marks every code 6.88g does not name, or whose 6.88g row an editor-strings override corrects, as UNVERIFIED (6.88g silent). Regeneration into a temp dir vs origin doodad-types-w3.tsv: DIFF_LINES=0 over 100 codes, 39 kindless all marked. Published 638eac606a0e080dc225fe33c14bed30e8c37343; ci-status green on that sha, 6/6 success (run 40166056548, dispatch 1792907010976-5055-79c333e5afa27388). Witness session verify-doodad-w3-generator-reships-withheld-kinds.
